description: Intent taxonomy derived from representative AmazonHelp customer-support conversations.

intents.name: Delivery Delay
intents.description: Customer reporting that their package has not arrived by the expected delivery date.
intents.customer_problem: Package is late or past the promised delivery window.
inclusion_criteria: Tracking status stuck or not updating
Requests for status update after delay
exclusion_criteria: Package marked delivered but not found (see missing_delivered)
example_messages: My order was not delivered. It was supposed to arrive yesterday.
It's already past the expected delivery date, where is my package?
historical_resolution_patterns: Ask for carrier/tracking details
Advise waiting until the following business day
Provide link to tracking/help page
Direct customer to contact support team via phone/chat

intents.name: Package Marked Delivered But Not Received
intents.customer_problem: Tracking says 'delivered', but the customer does not have the package.
inclusion_criteria: Tracking shows delivered but item missing
Package not found at designated safe place
exclusion_criteria: Stolen package reported by third party
example_messages: Why did you say you delivered my package an hour ago and it still isn’t here?
Tracking says delivered but I have nothing.
historical_resolution_patterns: Ask customer to verify delivery preferences
Request carrier info
Provide help page link for missing items
Direct to support team for formal investigation

intents.name: Damaged or Defective Item
intents.customer_problem: Received item is physically broken, cracked, or not functioning.
example_messages: I just received my order and the item is damaged.
The item arrived cracked and leaking.
historical_resolution_patterns: Express apology
Direct customer to return/replacement flow
Request order details for official claim

intents.name: Refund and Billing Issue
intents.customer_problem: Customer seeking money back or questioning unexpected charges.
example_messages: I was charged for an item I never received.
When will I get my refund?
historical_resolution_patterns: Direct to billing/account support
Explain refund processing timelines
Request customer to reply to official email correspondence

intents.name: Order Cancellation
intents.customer_problem: Customer wants to stop an order before it ships or complains about an unauthorized cancellation.
example_messages: Why was my order cancelled without my permission?
historical_resolution_patterns: Provide instructions on cancellation window
Direct to order history for self-service options
Suggest contacting support if order is already processing

intents.name: Account and Login Issue
intents.customer_problem: Customer unable to access their Amazon account.
exclusion_criteria: Order-specific issues not related to login
example_messages: I can't login to my account.
historical_resolution_patterns: Direct to account recovery help pages
Escalate to account security specialists
Provide official support link for sensitive issues

intents.name: Prime Membership
intents.customer_problem: Queries about Prime benefits, unwanted subscription charges, or sign-up issues.
example_messages: I was charged for prime but I'm not a prime member.
How do I cancel my prime subscription?
historical_resolution_patterns: Provide instructions to manage prime membership
Acknowledge dissatisfaction with charges
Direct to account service for billing help

intents.name: Technical and Digital Content
intents.customer_problem: Issues with apps, Kindle devices, or digital streaming content.
example_messages: My Kindle won't connect to the internet.
historical_resolution_patterns: Suggest device restart
Request device details/browser version
Direct to digital specialist support team

intents.name: Other / Unclear / Ambiguous
intents.description: Messages that are too vague, off-topic, or missing enough info to classify.
intents.customer_problem: General greetings, ambiguous queries, or noisy messages.
inclusion_criteria: Ambiguous messages not matching other categories
historical_resolution_patterns: Polite acknowledgement
Request for more details without account specifics
Suggest visiting help page
